verdict.rationale: GitHub's docs say you can clone a repository locally using Git and add remotes with `git remote add`. They also say SSH keys enable reading and writing repository data, and that Git can be used from the command line or GitHub Desktop. Push protection that blocks pushes, plus community users who clone and push routinely, corroborate standard Git push and clone workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of HTTPS transport and credentials, explicit coverage of pull/fetch, and a statement that arbitrary third-party Git clients are supported.
